name: companyId
label: Company ID
help: Your Redstor **Partner** company's ID in RedApp — found under **RedApp → Company Settings**. Every request is scoped to this company and its direct customers.

name: clientId
label: Client ID
placeholder: Enter the RedAPI service account Client ID
help: The Client ID of the RedAPI service account, created in RedApp → **RedAPI → Service accounts**.

name: privateKey
label: Private Key
help: The PEM-encoded private key downloaded when you created the service account's key in RedApp → **RedAPI → Service accounts**. Keep this secret — it authenticates as your Partner Admin. Paste the full key including the `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----` / `-----END PRIVATE KEY-----` lines.
